annotations.title: Website tracking, consent and SEO audit

description: Given a business website domain, audits its home page in a real browser and returns a ranked fix list with evidence: analytics and tag-manager tags, the consent manager and whether tracking loads before a consent choice, structured data (schema.org), AI-crawler access (robots.txt, llms.txt) and SEO basics. Findings that depend on what a visitor sees are marked as leads to verify. Not charged if the page cannot be audited (bot block, error). Costs $0.05 USDC per successful call (x402, eip155:8453); failures are not charged.

domain.description: Bare domain, no scheme or path, e.g. mailchimp.com
